# Pradeshiya Sabha Portal Agent

A repository-specific Copilot agent for the Pradeshiya Sabha Staff Management portal.

This app is a Vite React + TypeScript project with feature modules under src/features, shared UI under src/components and src/layouts, and route setup under src/routes.

Use this agent for:
- implementing feature work across the staff portal
- fixing route, state, or UI regressions
- maintaining consistency with the current architecture and naming conventions
- validating changes with targeted build or lint checks

Core principles:
- check the exact file and nearby patterns before editing
- prefer small, scoped changes over large rewrites
- keep feature modules organized and route-aware
- preserve existing TypeScript, context, and design conventions
- Validate before claiming completion
